Name: Governance charter
Description: Approved governance charter defining roles, decision rights, and scope.

Name: RACI matrix
Description: Role-to-responsibility matrix for ecosystem operations and escalation.

Name: Policy change log
Description: Machine-readable log of policy/schema/registry changes with version identifiers.

Name: Decision log entries
Description: Signed/tamper-evident governance decisions with rationale and attribution.

Name: Registry publication metadata
Description: Registry/list publication includes timestamp, provenance, and update cadence.

Name: Registry signing keys & rotation record
Description: Key inventory and rotation events for registry signing keys.

Name: Issuer onboarding evidence
Description: Eligibility checks, authorization, and onboarding approvals for issuers.

Name: Issuance audit trail sample
Description: Sample issuance events with subject binding and policy checks.

Name: Revocation/status evidence
Description: Status list or revocation records demonstrating lifecycle management.

Name: Verifier validation checklist
Description: Verifier process showing checks for authorization, status, schema, policy.

Name: Incident runbook & escalation
Description: Operational incident response playbook and escalation paths.

Name: Dependency inventory
Description: Inventory of critical dependencies with SLAs and fallback plans.

Name: Schema governance record
Description: Schema versions, compatibility notes, and breaking-change documentation.

Name: Dispute/redress procedure
Description: Publicly accessible process for disputes and corrections, with timelines.

Name: User disclosure text
Description: Plain-language disclosures about trust signals, errors, and recourse.

Name: Runtime decision receipt
Description: Structured record of a runtime decision including request; authority basis; policy; evidence inputs; verdict; and effect

Name: Runtime policy evaluation trace
Description: Tamper-evident trace showing policy admission checks immediately before a runtime effect

Name: Fail-safe behavior test evidence
Description: Test outputs proving deny/suspend/degrade behavior under stale or missing runtime governance inputs

Name: TSMM runtime governance projection
Description: Projection of actor effect boundary authority policy evidence status and audit expectation into executable runtime assurance artifacts

Name: Authority boundary
Description: Bounded authority evidence preserving source delegation path scope lifecycle state and revocation obligations

Name: Status-list reference
Description: Status or revocation reference showing active suspended revoked expired or unknown state and freshness metadata

Name: Trust Task execution receipt
Description: Runtime task receipt separating lifecycle state decision outcome and effect admission

Name: Integrity-bound evidence bundle
Description: Evidence bundle manifest with artifact inventory hashes canonicalization bundle digest proof or signature metadata

Name: Registry publication profile
Description: Publication evidence showing discoverable artifact chain assurance posture and discovery-versus-authorization boundary

Name: AIS-1 v0.2 bond verification package
Description: AIS-1 DID resolution registry status bond hash tier issuer sponsor agentClass parentDid and timestamp service evidence

Name: AIS-1 assurance container reference
Description: Versioned append-only attestation container reference including legal compliance audit valuation or government VC attestations where applicable

Name: AIS-1 SOA parent-chain and cascade revocation evidence
Description: SOA parent ALA status cascade revocation checks and negative-path outcomes for unavailable suspended or revoked parent state
